recipes.name: Basic Scrambled Eggs

items: ⅛ tsp black pepper (or to taste)

steps: Crack eggs into a measuring cup.
Add the milk (if desired) and salt.
Using a whisk or fork, beat the mixture until foamy.
Melt butter in a frying pan on medium heat
Pour eggs into frying pan.
Stir mixture to break up the egg as it cooks and allow more liquid to touch the hot pan. Stirring rapidly will create small curds, while slower stirring will create larger curds.

Cook until just before you feel that they are done, since the eggs will continue to cook after being removed from the pan. The eggs are done when the sheen disappears; stop cooking just before this happens.
Transfer to a plate. Season with black pepper (black pepper will burn and become bitter if seasoned before cooking).
Eat as is or with ketchup (tomato sauce), salsa, and/or butter on toast.
notes: For a low-sodium version, omit salt and use unsalted butter.
Grated cheddar cheese can be added into the mixture or on top of the cooked eggs.
Sour cream may be used in place of milk for a creamier and richer version.

Cook ⅓ cup (25 g / 0.88 oz) of crumbled cooked meats (like bacon or sausage) or chopped vegetables (like mushrooms or bell pepper) for a couple of minutes before adding the egg mixture. See also Southwestern Scramble.
recipes.assumptions: Includes the optional milk (2.5 tbsp). Excludes toast and toppings.

recipes.name: Banana Pancakes

ingredients.heading: Dry
items: 300 grams self-raising flour (or 300 grams all-purpose flour + 1 tablespoon baking powder)

steps: Melt the butter in a medium-size heat-safe mixing bowl.
Add the bananas, and mash the bananas and butter together with a potato masher.
Add the eggs and continue to mash until smooth.
Gradually stir in the milk with a wooden spoon.
In a separate large bowl, whisk together the dry ingredients.
Slowly mix the wet ingredients into the dry to get a batter.
Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat.
For each round of frying, grease the pan with a little extra butter. Pour about ⅓ cup of batter onto the pan for each pancake, making sure they don't run into each other.
Cook the pancakes on on medium-low heat for about 3 minutes on each side until the side is lightly browned. You can tell if it's time to turn the pancake if you can see bubbles on the other side.
Flip the pancakes using a spatula, and cook through on the other side.
Remove the pancakes from the pan, and repeat the cooking process with the remaining batter.
notes: If using salted butter, omit the extra salt in the ingredients.
recipes.assumptions: Uses 5 servings. Excludes syrup and any oil or butter used to grease the pan.

recipes.name: Granola
steps: Combine all ingredients except the raisins and blueberries.
Spread the mixture on a tray and bake for 1 hour at 250°F, stirring every 10 minutes.
Let cool, then mix in the raisins and blueberries.
recipes.assumptions: The page gives no yield. This assumes 16 servings of about 2/3 cup. It is calorie-dense, so a smaller bowl is normal.

recipes.name: Red Lentil Soup
steps: Pick over the lentils to remove any debris if needed. Rinse well.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Once oil is hot, add the onion and carrots. Sauté for a few minutes, until the vegetables have started to soften, then add the garlic.
Add the lentils, bay leaf, and water to the pot. Simmer over low-medium heat for 20–30 minutes until lentils are softened.
Serve hot.
notes: Herbs and/or spices can be added to the sautéing vegetables, such as cumin, thyme, oregano, and/or red pepper flakes.
Hot sauce can be added to taste. Freshly-squeezed lemon juice is a nice addition, preferably immediately before serving.
recipes.assumptions: Made with water (not stock) and 1.5 tbsp olive oil (the page says 1-2).

recipes.name: Tuna Salad

ingredients.heading: Variation I
items: 1 can water chestnuts, drained and chopped

steps: Mix all ingredients in a bowl.
Chill before serving.
Serve on toast.
recipes.assumptions: Variation I only. Assumes the tuna and water chestnuts are drained. Excludes the toast it is served on.

recipes.name: Black Bean Soup
steps: Pick over the beans.
Place in large bean pot and add water to cover by at least 2 inches (~5 cm).
Soak overnight, then change water.
Bring beans to a boil. Reduce heat, then simmer until beans start to soften, around ½ hour.
Add bay leaves, bell peppers, chili powder, cumin, garlic, jalapeños, onions, and red wine vinegar.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer ½ to 1 hour, until beans are soft.
Take out bay leaves.
Stir in cilantro.
Add some sour cream.
Serve.
recipes.assumptions: Uses 1.5 jalapeños and counts the optional sour cream garnish in full. Salt and pepper 'to taste' are not counted, so sodium may be higher. Needs overnight soaking and about 2 hours of cooking.

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Breasts
steps: Brush both sides of chicken with olive oil. Sprinkle both sides liberally with kosher salt, freshly ground black pepper, and finely grated lemon zest.
Place chicken on a 13x9-inch baking pan. Insert a probe thermometer into one of the chicken breasts and bake in the center of a 400°F (200°C) oven until internal temperature reaches 165°F (75°C).
Remove to a plate and let rest 5 minutes. Serve warm.
recipes.assumptions: The page gives no amounts for oil, salt or zest. Assumes 1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp zest and 170 g raw per breast.

recipes.name: Rosemary Grilled Salmon Steaks
steps: Combine the oil, vinegar, rosemary, and pepper. Add salmon steaks, and marinate for 15 minutes.
Place the steaks on a hot grill, cooking on each side for 3 minutes until flaky.
notes: Use cedar/alder planks or charcoal for added flavor.
recipes.assumptions: Uses farmed Atlantic salmon and counts all of the marinade, although some drips off, so real figures are slightly lower.

recipes.name: Chicken Fajitas

items: 1–2 lb (½–1 kg) skinless, boneless chicken breast
1 Tbsp crushed red pepper (or to taste)

steps: Cut chicken into roughly 1x1-inch (2.5 x 2.5 cm) pieces.
Marinate the chicken with a spoonful of turmeric, salt and black pepper.
Cook chicken in olive oil, cumin and red pepper over high heat in a large skillet or wok.
While meat is cooking, chop/julienne vegetables peppers and onion).
When meat is completely cooked, add vegetables, stirring frequently so that all are evenly cooked.
Remove from heat when vegetables are soft.
Serve with tortilla shells and toppings such as cheese, sour cream, lettuce, tomato, onions, and/or guacamole.
recipes.assumptions: Assumes 1.5 lb of chicken and 4 servings. Calories are for the filling only: tortillas and toppings are not included.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Berry Parfait
steps: Toast the oats in a dry skillet over medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring, until they smell nutty. Stir in the cinnamon and let cool.
Slice the strawberries.
Layer the yogurt, berries and toasted oats into two glasses or bowls.
Drizzle the honey on top and serve right away.

recipes.name: Veggie Egg Muffins

items: 1 tsp olive oil for the pan

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and lightly oil a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk the eggs with the salt and pepper.
Divide the spinach, pepper, onion and cheese among the 12 cups, then pour in the eggs.
Bake 18 to 22 minutes, until the centers are set and the eggs reach 160°F.
Cool 5 minutes, then loosen with a knife. They keep 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.name: Avocado Egg Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and salt.
Fry the eggs in the olive oil over medium heat until the whites are set, about 3 minutes.
Spread the avocado on the toast, top with the eggs, and finish with black pepper and crushed red pepper.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Overnight Oats
steps: Whisk the milk, peanut butter, chia and cinnamon together in a bowl until smooth.
Stir in the oats and divide between two jars.
Cover and chill at least 4 hours or overnight.
Top with the sliced banana before eating, cold or warmed.

recipes.name: Turmeric Tofu Scramble
steps: Press the tofu between towels for 5 minutes, then crumble it with your hands into small pieces.
Heat the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper for 3 minutes, add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the tofu, turmeric, salt and pepper. Cook 5 minutes, stirring, until the tofu is hot and golden.
Fold in the spinach until wilted, about 1 minute, and serve.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Smoothie
steps: Add the milk, bananas, peanut butter, oats and honey to a blender.
Blend on high for 1 minute until completely smooth.
Pour into two glasses and drink right away.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Hash with Eggs
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sweet potato, cover, and cook 8 minutes, stirring once.
Add the onion, pepper, paprika, salt and pepper. Cook uncovered 6 to 8 minutes until the potatoes are tender and browned.
Make two wells in the hash and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook 3 to 4 minutes until the whites are set.
Serve straight from the pan.

recipes.name: Banana Oat Pancakes
steps: Blend the bananas, oats, eggs, milk, baking powder and cinnamon until smooth. Let the batter rest 5 minutes.
Melt a little butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour in 1/4 cup of batter per pancake. Cook 2 to 3 minutes until bubbles form, flip, and cook 1 to 2 minutes more.
Serve topped with the strawberries.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese Pineapple Bowl
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into two bowls.
Top with the pineapple, sunflower seeds and chia seeds.
Eat immediately for the best crunch.

recipes.name: Strawberry Almond Chia Pudding
steps: Whisk the almond milk, chia seeds, mashed banana and cinnamon in a bowl.
Wait 5 minutes and whisk again to break up clumps.
Cover and chill at least 4 hours or overnight until thick.
Stir, divide into bowls and top with the strawberries.

recipes.name: Black Bean Breakfast Burritos
steps: Whisk the eggs with the salt. Scramble them in the oil over medium heat until just set, about 3 minutes.
Warm the beans in a small pan or microwave. Warm the tortillas.
Fill each tortilla with eggs, beans, spinach, cheese and salsa.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Serve warm.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Feta Omelet
steps: Beat the eggs with the pepper and oregano.
Heat half the oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Pour in half the eggs and cook 2 minutes, lifting the edges so uncooked egg flows underneath.
Scatter half the spinach, tomato and feta on one side, fold the omelet over, and cook 1 more minute.
Slide onto a plate and repeat with the remaining ingredients.

recipes.name: Chicken and Broccoli Rice Bowl

items: 3/4 lb boneless skinless chicken breast, cubed

steps: Cook the rice according to the package.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken 5 to 6 minutes until browned and cooked through (165°F). Move to a plate.
Add the broccoli, carrots, garlic and ginger with 3 tbsp water. Cover 3 minutes, then uncover and cook 2 more until tender-crisp.
Return the chicken, add the soy sauce, and toss for 1 minute. Serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Smashed Chickpea Salad Wrap
steps: Mash the chickpeas with a fork in a bowl, leaving some texture.
Stir in the celery, onion, lemon juice, oil, mustard and pepper.
Lay a romaine leaf on each tortilla and spoon the chickpea salad on top.
Roll up tightly, cut in half and serve.

recipes.name: Turkey Hummus Veggie Wrap
steps: Spread the hummus over each tortilla.
Layer on the turkey, romaine, tomato and cucumber.
Fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Slice in half and serve.

recipes.name: Quinoa Black Bean Bowl
steps: Rinse the quinoa, then simmer it in 1 cup water, covered, for 15 minutes. Fluff and let steam 5 minutes.
Warm the beans and corn with the cumin and salt.
Divide the quinoa between bowls and top with the beans, corn and tomato.
Add the avocado, squeeze the lime over it, and sprinkle with cilantro.

recipes.name: Tuna and White Bean Salad

items: 2 cans (5 oz) tuna in water, drained

steps: Flake the tuna into a bowl.
Add the beans, celery, onion, lemon juice, oil and pepper and toss gently.
Serve over the chopped romaine.

recipes.name: Hearty Minestrone Soup

items: 2 oz spaghetti, broken into short pieces
1 cup green beans, cut in pieces

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrot and celery for 6 minutes. Add the garlic and oregano for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, 4 cups water and the salt. Bring to a boil, then simmer 10 minutes.
Add the green beans, beans and pasta. Simmer 10 to 12 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve.

recipes.name: Veggie Egg Fried Rice

items: 1/2 cup uncooked white rice (or 1 1/2 cups leftover cooked rice)

steps: Cook the rice ahead and cool it (day-old rice fries best).
Heat half the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Scramble the eggs for 1 minute and move them to a plate.
Add the rest of the oil, then the onion, carrot and garlic. Cook 3 minutes. Add the peas and cook 1 minute.
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir-fry 3 minutes. Return the eggs and toss.

recipes.name: Lentil and Spinach Stew
steps: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot 6 minutes, add the garlic, cumin and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, salt and 3 cups water. Bring to a boil, then simmer, partly covered, 25 to 30 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts, about 2 minutes. Add a splash of water if it is too thick.

recipes.name: Caprese Pasta Salad
steps: Cook the pasta until just tender, drain, and rinse under cool water.
Toss the pasta with the oil, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Fold in the tomatoes, mozzarella and basil.
Serve at room temperature or chilled.

recipes.name: Chicken Greek Salad
steps: Rub the chicken with half the oil and the oregano. Cook in a skillet over medium heat 5 to 6 minutes per side until it reaches 165°F. Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Whisk the remaining oil with the lemon juice.
Toss the romaine, cucumber, tomato and onion with the dressing.
Top with the chicken and feta.

recipes.name: Shrimp and Veggie Noodle Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the noodles until just tender and drain.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat. Stir-fry the broccoli and pepper 4 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the shrimp and cook 2 to 3 minutes until pink and opaque.
Add the noodles and soy sauce, toss 1 minute, and serve.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Black Bean Tacos
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potato with the oil, cumin and chili powder and roast on a sheet pan 20 to 25 minutes, turning once.
Warm the beans. Warm the tortillas in a dry pan.
Fill the tortillas with the sweet potato, beans and cabbage.
Top with the avocado and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Salmon with Potatoes and Broccoli

items: 3/4 lb salmon fillet, cut in 2 portions

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potatoes with half the oil, salt and pepper on a large sheet pan and roast 15 minutes.
Toss the broccoli with the rest of the oil and the garlic. Push the potatoes aside and add the broccoli.
Season the salmon with paprika and lemon juice and place it on the pan.
Roast 10 to 12 minutes more until the salmon reaches 145°F and flakes easily.

recipes.name: Weeknight Turkey Chili
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Cook the turkey, breaking it up, until no pink remains and it reaches 165°F, about 7 minutes.
Add the onion and pepper and cook 5 minutes. Add the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Stir in the tomatoes, both cans of beans with their liquid, the salt and 1 cup water.
Simmer uncovered 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.

recipes.name: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry

items: 3/4 lb sirloin steak, sliced thin against the grain

steps: Cook the rice. Mix the soy sauce, brown sugar and 1/4 cup water in a small bowl.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over high heat. Sear the beef in a single layer 1 to 2 minutes per side. Move to a plate.
Add the broccoli with 2 tbsp water, cover 3 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the beef, pour in the sauce, and cook 1 to 2 minutes until glossy. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Spaghetti with Turkey Meat Sauce
steps: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion 5 minutes, add the garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the turkey and cook, breaking it up, until no pink remains and it reaches 165°F.
Stir in the tomatoes, oregano, salt and pepper. Simmer 20 minutes until thickened.
Meanwhile cook the spaghetti, drain, and toss with the sauce. Top with the Parmesan.

recipes.name: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
steps: Cook the rice. Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat and cook the onion 6 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, salt and 1/2 cup water. Simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken it.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve over the rice.

recipes.name: Crispy Tofu Veggie Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Press the tofu 10 minutes between towels, then cut into 3/4-inch cubes.
Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Brown the tofu on all sides, about 8 minutes. Move to a plate.
Add the broccoli, carrot and pepper with 3 tbsp water. Cover 3 minutes, then cook uncovered 2 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the tofu, add the soy sauce, toss 1 minute, and serve over the rice.

recipes.name: One-Pan Shrimp and Rice Skillet
steps: Heat the oil in a large deep skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion and pepper 5 minutes. Add the garlic, paprika and red pepper for 30 seconds.
Add the rice, tomatoes, salt and 1 cup water. Cover and simmer on low 15 minutes.
Nestle the shrimp into the rice, cover, and cook 5 to 6 minutes until the shrimp are pink and the rice is tender.
Fluff with a fork and serve.

recipes.name: Pork Chops with Sweet Potato and Green Beans

items: 2 boneless pork loin chops (about 6 oz each)
2 small sweet potatoes, cut in wedges

steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potato wedges with 2 tsp oil and half the salt and roast on a sheet pan 15 minutes.
Rub the chops with the paprika, pepper and remaining salt. Toss the green beans with 1 tsp oil and the garlic and add them to the pan.
Sear the chops in a hot skillet with the last tsp of oil, 3 minutes per side.
Move the chops to the sheet pan and roast 5 to 7 minutes until they reach 145°F. Rest 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Black Bean Quesadillas with Side Salad
steps: Mash half the beans with the cumin and mix in the whole beans and pepper.
Spread the bean mix and cheese on half of each tortilla and fold over.
Cook in a dry skillet over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and the cheese melts.
Toss the romaine and tomato with the lime juice and oil. Serve with the quesadillas.

recipes.name: Baked Cod with Tomatoes and Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the potato slices with half the oil and half the salt, spread in a baking dish, and roast 15 minutes.
Layer the tomatoes and garlic over the potatoes and sprinkle with the oregano.
Place the cod on top, drizzle with the remaining oil and the lemon juice, and season with the rest of the salt and pepper.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until the cod reaches 145°F and flakes easily.

recipes.name: Beef and Rice Stuffed Peppers

items: 4 large bell peppers, tops cut off and seeded

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook the rice according to the package.
Cook the onion in the oil 4 minutes. Add the beef and garlic and cook until no pink remains (160°F). Stir in the rice, tomatoes, salt and oregano.
Stand the peppers in a baking dish and fill them with the mixture. Add 1/4 cup water to the dish and cover with foil.
Bake 35 minutes, uncover, top with the cheese, and bake 5 more minutes until melted.

recipes.name: Garlicky Mushroom Spinach Pasta
steps: Cook the spaghetti, saving 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain.
Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the mushrooms 6 to 7 minutes until browned. Add the garlic and red pepper for 30 seconds.
Add the spinach and salt and cook until wilted, 1 to 2 minutes.
Toss in the pasta with a splash of pasta water, the pepper and the Parmesan.

recipes.name: Savory Chickpea Breakfast Skillet
steps: Heat the oil in a skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion 3 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin and paprika for 30 seconds.
Add the chickpeas and tomato and cook 6 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas with the back of a spoon.
Stir in the spinach, salt and pepper until the spinach wilts, about 1 minute.
Spoon into bowls and serve hot.

recipes.name: Avocado Black Bean Breakfast Tacos
steps: Warm the beans in a small pan with the salt for 3 minutes, mashing about half.
Warm the tortillas in a dry skillet, 30 seconds per side.
Fill each tortilla with beans and avocado.
Top with the salsa, cilantro and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Warm Berry Walnut Oatmeal
steps: Bring the almond milk to a simmer in a saucepan.
Stir in the oats and cinnamon and cook 5 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Fold in half the blueberries and cook 1 more minute.
Divide into bowls and top with the remaining blueberries and the walnuts.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Almond Milk Smoothie
steps: Add the almond milk, bananas, peanut butter and chia seeds to a blender.
Blend on high for 1 minute until smooth and thick.
Pour into two glasses and serve right away.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
steps: Toast the bread until golden.
Spread the peanut butter on each slice.
Layer on the banana slices and sprinkle with the cinnamon.

recipes.name: Berry Seed Yogurt Bowl
steps: Spoon the yogurt into two bowls.
Top with the strawberries, blueberries, sunflower seeds and chia seeds.
Drizzle with the honey and serve.

recipes.name: Mediterranean Chickpea Quinoa Salad
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in 1 cup water, covered, 15 minutes. Fluff and cool 10 minutes.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil, oregano and salt.
Toss the quinoa with the chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, onion and dressing.
Serve at room temperature or chilled.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Red Lentil Soup

items: 2 small sweet potatoes, peeled and diced

steps: Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat. Cook the onion and carrot 5 minutes, then the garlic, cumin and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, lentils, salt and 4 cups water. Bring to a boil.
Simmer, partly covered, 20 minutes until everything is soft.
Mash lightly with a spoon or blend part of it for a thicker soup.

recipes.name: Corn and Black Bean Salad Bowl
steps: Combine the beans, corn, tomato and pepper in a bowl.
Stir in the lime juice, cumin, salt and cilantro.
Fold in the avocado gently just before serving.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato Black Bean Chili

items: 2 small sweet potatoes, peeled and diced

steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion 5 minutes, then the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, both cans of beans with their liquid, the salt and 1 1/2 cups water.
Simmer, partly covered, 25 to 30 minutes until the sweet potato is tender and the chili is thick.
Taste and add salt if needed.

recipes.name: Lentil Bolognese Spaghetti
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat. Cook the onion, carrot and celery 8 minutes, then the garlic and oregano for 1 minute.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, salt and 1 1/2 cups water. Simmer, partly covered, 30 minutes until the lentils are soft and the sauce is thick.
Cook the spaghetti, drain, and top with the sauce.

recipes.name: Quinoa Black Bean Stuffed Peppers

items: 4 large bell peppers, tops cut off and seeded

steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Simmer the quinoa in 1 cup water, covered, for 15 minutes.
Cook the onion in the oil 4 minutes. Stir in the quinoa, beans, corn, half the tomatoes, cumin and salt.
Stand the peppers in a baking dish, fill them with the mixture, and pour the remaining tomatoes around them. Cover with foil.
Bake 35 minutes, then uncover and bake 5 more minutes.

recipes.name: Roasted Veggie and White Bean Quinoa Bowl
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss the sweet potato with half the oil and half the salt and roast 15 minutes.
Add the broccoli, garlic and remaining oil, salt and pepper to the pan and roast 15 more minutes.
Meanwhile simmer the quinoa in 1 1/2 cups water, covered, 15 minutes.
Warm the beans, then pile everything over the quinoa and squeeze the lemon on top.

recipes.name: Peanut Noodle Bowl
steps: Cook the noodles, saving 1/2 cup of the cooking water, then drain.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, ginger, garlic and red pepper with 1/4 cup of the hot noodle water until smooth.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, adding more water if it is thick.
Top with the cucumber and carrot and serve warm or cold.

recipes.name: White Bean Tomato Basil Pasta
steps: Cook the spaghetti and drain, saving a little pasta water.
Warm the oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the garlic and red pepper 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, salt and pepper and simmer 10 minutes, lightly crushing some beans.
Toss in the pasta, adding pasta water if needed, and finish with the basil.

recipes.name: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Prick the sweet potatoes and bake on a sheet pan 40 to 45 minutes until soft.
Meanwhile cook the onion and garlic in the oil 3 minutes. Add the chickpeas and cook 4 minutes, then the spinach until wilted.
Split the potatoes open and mash the flesh slightly.
Fill with the chickpea-spinach mix, top with the feta and pepper, and serve.

recipes.name: Spinach Mushroom Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Whisk the eggs with the salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a 10-inch oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Cook the onion and mushrooms 6 minutes, then the spinach 1 minute.
Pour in the eggs and sprinkle with the cheese. Cook 2 minutes without stirring.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until set in the center (160°F). Let it rest 5 minutes and cut into wedges.
